blogs.title: "When Early Onset Pancytopenia Meets Fibrosis – Why Telomeres Should Be on Your Radar"
blogs.description:
"Young adults whose anemia persists despite corrected B12 deficiency raise suspicion for inherited bone marrow failure syndromes.
This post walks through a step-wise work-up—from basic labs and bone marrow morphology revealing ineffective erythropoiesis through targeted imaging that uncovers covert hepatic fibrosis—and shows why a telomere-length assay and exome sequencing become vital next steps."

blogs.title: "PARN Mutations – The Hidden Maestro Behind Dyskeratosis Congenita Spectrum"
blogs.description:
"PARN governs deadenylation of the shelterin component TERC RNA—a keystone step in telomerase assembly.
We dissect how monoallelic versus biallelic loss translate into atypical pulmonary fibrosis versus classic DC features respectively,
review computational prediction supports for novel missense variants such as c.Cys205Arg
and explain why such hits often sit at the boundary between ‘VUS’ and ‘likely pathogenic’."

blogs.title: "Silent Cirrhosis Hidden by Telomeropathy – Why Livers Go SICK Without Alcohol"
blogs.description:
"Telomerase defects leave rapidly turning hepatocytes starved of replication capacity,
driving progressive nodule formation before overt jaundice sets in.
This article reviews elastography criteria that flag moderate-to-severe fibrosis even when routine hepatitis panels are negative
and outlines surveillance algorithms tailored to young users already harbouring multi-system frailty."

blogs.title: "Pulmonary Fibrosis at 27 - Is It Idiopathic or Genetic?"
blogs.description:
"Adult-onset diffuse interstitial lung disease below age 30 is uncommon until a breath-stopper surfaces—and monogenic etiologies lurk behind it.
Spotting HRCT patterns such as subpleural subphrenic atelectasis can clue clinicians toward a telomeropathy work-up versus classic age-related IPF cohorts awaiting RAPD-based trials."

blogs.title: "From Cobalamin Injections to Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation – Therapeutic Roadmap"
blogs.description:
"Supportive measures such as high-dose cyanocobalamin alleviate marginal symptoms yet cannot arrest organ decline once fibrosis begins.
Here we chart evidence-based algorithms—from cyprobetadine salvage for anemia through androgen bridge therapy all the way
to conditioning modification needed before an orthotopic liver–pulmonary mixed transplant becomes viable."

blogs.title: "Genetic Counseling When a Variant Is Uncertain — Navigating Family Risk & Patient Hope"
blogs.description:
"When whole-exome sequencing surfaces a de novo missense hit trailed by ACMG ‘VUS’ status—as c.Cys205Arg—the clinician’s job expands beyond medical care into psycho-social stewardship.
We outline tiered family testing strategies,
explain longitudinal reclassification frameworks using ClinVar updates equalized against functional readouts,
and preview reproductive options such as preimplantation genetic diagnosis."
